about: Exceptions to how `rerun` carries a recipe's first run's parameters to another model.
By default a parameter is kept only where the catalogue (GET /v1/models) says the model
takes it: a size it lists, or its default size; a count up to its max_n (1 when it states
none); a clip length it lists, or its default length. Anything else is left out, and the
plan says what and why. A video always states its seconds: the model's default when the
allow: values a model is confirmed to take beyond what the catalogue lists,
map: a value to send instead of another, for one model,
Add an entry only when the provider's own documentation confirms it, with that page
named in the commit. None is seeded yet: the catalogue lists sizes for gpt-image-1.5
only, and clip lengths for no video model.
